Description: Framedash self-hosted: one EC2 instance, encrypted retained data volume, SQS and S3. Requires an existing subnet and explicit account verification.

Metadata.ExpectedAccountId: Deployment tooling must compare STS caller Account to ExpectedAccountId before creating or updating this stack.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: One host runs shared application images and private local databases; managed queues and object storage survive host replacement.
must: Account must match ExpectedAccountId in the deployment workflow.
One instance only; auto-stop bounds runtime, not total spend.
No inbound access in the default SSM-only install.

AvailabilityZone.Description: Zone of the host subnet: InstanceSubnetId when set, otherwise PublicSubnetId. With the ALB it must also be the zone of PublicSubnetId or AlbSecondSubnetId.

AllowedClientCidr.Description: Operator or office IPv4 CIDR allowed to use HTTPS, with prefix 1 through 32. All /0 CIDRs, including 0.0.0.0/0, are forbidden.

InstanceType.Description: One instance only. t3.xlarge has 16 GiB, the tested runtime size; t3.large is an optional cheaper runtime test.

AutoStopHours.Description: Initial host-bootstrap timer setting; 0 installs no timer and requires AmiImageId. Updating this parameter does not update the installed timer on an existing host.

EnableAlb.Description: Serve HTTPS through an Application Load Balancer with an ACM certificate instead of the loopback-only route. Mutually exclusive with EnablePublicHttps.

AlbScheme.Description: internal needs an existing VPN or private route from every client device; internet-facing still admits only AllowedClientCidr.

AlbCertificateArn.Description: Required with EnableAlb. An ACM-issued, DNS-validated certificate in this Region renews automatically; imported certificates do not.

AlbSecondSubnetId.Description: Required with EnableAlb. A second subnet of VpcId in a different Availability Zone; the ALB also uses PublicSubnetId so the host zone is always enabled.

NoncurrentVersionRetentionDays.Description: Whole days S3 keeps replaced or deleted object versions before permanent expiry; 0 keeps them indefinitely. Enabling expiry also deletes existing versions older than this.

InstanceSubnetId.Description: Optional private subnet for the host, in AvailabilityZone, with a NAT route. Requires EnableAlb. PublicSubnetId stays the first ALB subnet. Run aws/preflight.mjs first.

AmiImageId.Description: Optional fixed AMI that overrides AmiId. Required with AutoStopHours 0, because AmiId re-resolves on stack update and a new image replaces the host.

AlarmTopicArn.Description: Optional SNS topic that receives alarms. Requires AutoStopHours 0, because a stopped host stops reporting and that breaches.

MaintenanceAlarmMinutes.Description: Minutes the ALB may stay unhealthy before alarming. Must exceed the nightly backup run time, which stops the proxy.

BackupRetentionDays.Description: When nonzero, creates a write-only backup bucket that expires backups after this many days and removes them 7 days later, so a host that overwrites a backup cannot destroy it at once. Erased data remains until then.

Assertions.AssertDescription: EnableAlb and EnablePublicHttps are mutually exclusive.
EnableAlb requires the office or VPN CIDR in AllowedClientCidr.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: The default consumer leaves failed telemetry in the DLQ for operator diagnosis, subject to SQS retention expiry.
must: Do not consume the DLQ automatically; explicit discard deletes acknowledged messages and retention expiry also removes them.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Durable delivery separates request acceptance from database availability.
must: Consumer processing must tolerate repeat delivery.
Preserve the dead-letter queue relationship.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Uploaded assets survive application-host loss without exposing data publicly.
must: Keep encryption and public-access blocking.
Keep noncurrent-version expiry opt-in: a new lifecycle rule also expires versions already in an upgraded bucket.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Transport enforcement also applies to requests allowed by identity policies.
must: Deny insecure transport; do not add public allow statements.
Retain the transport policy with its retained bucket.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Instance identity avoids static AWS credentials in the application distribution.
must: Application grants remain scoped to this stack queues and bucket.
Do not grant secret-read or account-administration actions to the application role.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: EC2 supplies rotating workload credentials through instance metadata.
must: Keep the instance role relationship; no user access keys.

Properties.GroupDescription: Framedash optional HTTP/HTTPS for the nominated CIDR; no default ingress.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: SSM access removes the need for inbound administration ports.
must: The default has no inbound rules.
Do not expose PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis or SSH.
Optional public listeners remain scoped to the nominated client CIDR.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: A separate persistent disk permits cold backup independently of disposable application images.
must: Zone must match the selected subnet and instance.
Keep encryption and snapshot policies on deletion or replacement.
Bootstrap never formats disks. The operator must positively verify a newly created blank volume before its explicit initialization during the bounded bootstrap wait.

Fn::Join:
'
finish_bootstrap() {
  status=$?
  trap - EXIT
  set +e
  for attempt in $(seq 1 5); do
    /opt/aws/bin/cfn-signal -e "$status" --stack "$stack_name" --resource Instance --region "$region" && exit "$status"
    sleep 5
  done
  exit 1
}
trap finish_bootstrap EXIT

if test "$auto_stop_hours" != 0; then
cat > /etc/systemd/system/framedash-autostop.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Stop the Framedash pilot instance
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/shutdown -h now
EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/framedash-autostop.timer <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Bound the Framedash pilot runtime
[Timer]
OnBootSec=${auto_stop_hours}h
Unit=framedash-autostop.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now framedash-autostop.timer
fi

dnf install -y aws-cfn-bootstrap docker git nodejs22 nodejs22-npm
alternatives --set node /usr/bin/node-22
node -e 'if (process.versions.node.split(".")[0] !== "22") process.exit(1)'
systemctl disable --now docker
install -d /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
compose_version=v2.39.4
compose_sha256=7af95166a730b87e172d4fc9aefea8725d3c6c7327d59149267b452114ddb7d4
curl --fail --location "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/$compose_version/docker-compose-linux-x86_64" -o /tmp/docker-compose-linux-x86_64
echo "$compose_sha256  /tmp/docker-compose-linux-x86_64" | sha256sum --check
install -m 755 /tmp/docker-compose-linux-x86_64 /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
volume_id=

volume_serial=${volume_id//-/}
device=/dev/disk/by-id/nvme-Amazon_Elastic_Block_Store_$volume_serial
for attempt in $(seq 1 120); do
  test -b "$device" && break
  sleep 5
done
test -b "$device"
wait_for_data_filesystem() {
  deadline=$((SECONDS + 1200))
  udevadm settle --timeout=10
  while ((SECONDS < deadline)); do
    if filesystem=$(blkid --probe -s TYPE -o value "$device"); then
      test "$filesystem" = ext4 || return 1
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 5
  done
  return 1
}
printf 'Waiting up to 20 minutes for operator-initialized ext4 on the exact data volume.\n'
wait_for_data_filesystem
install -d /srv/framedash
uuid=$(blkid --probe -s UUID -o value "$device")
test -n "$uuid"
grep -q "$uuid" /etc/fstab || printf 'UUID=%s /srv/framedash ext4 defaults,nofail,x-systemd.device-timeout=120s 0 2\n' "$uuid" >> /etc/fstab
mount /srv/framedash
printf '#!/bin/bash\nset -euo pipefail\nmountpoint -q /srv/framedash\ntest "$(findmnt -rn -o UUID --mountpoint /srv/framedash)" = "%s"\n' "$uuid" > /usr/local/sbin/framedash-data-ready
chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/framedash-data-ready
/usr/local/sbin/framedash-data-ready
install -d /etc/systemd/system/docker.service.d
cat > /etc/systemd/system/docker.service.d/framedash-data.conf <<'EOF'
[Unit]
RequiresMountsFor=/srv/framedash
BindsTo=srv-framedash.mount
After=srv-framedash.mount
[Service]
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/sbin/framedash-data-ready
EOF
install -d -m 700 /srv/framedash/data
if test ! -e /etc/docker/daemon.json; then
  test -z "$(ls -A /var/lib/docker 2>/dev/null)"
  install -d -m 711 /srv/framedash/docker
  install -d -m 755 /etc/docker
  printf '{"data-root":"/srv/framedash/docker"}\n' > /etc/docker/daemon.json
fi
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now docker
test "$(docker info --format '{{.DockerRootDir}}')" = /srv/framedash/docker
printf 'Framedash infrastructure ready; application installation and secret configuration are manual.\n'

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: A single host limits complexity and avoids managed-database and NAT fixed costs. The managed VPC rule reads only top-level SubnetId; pilot.guard verifies the actual network-interface subnet instead.
must: Install the auto-stop timer before dependencies so setup failure remains bounded.
Require IMDSv2 with a container-compatible hop limit.
Attach the existing data volume within this resource to avoid a signal/attachment dependency cycle.
Signal successful creation only after Node 22, the exact data mount and guarded Docker startup pass.
Docker must stop or refuse startup if the data mount disappears or its UUID changes.
Use standard CPU credits and preserve termination protection.
Place Docker's data root on the data volume before Docker first starts; never move an existing data root.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Optional stable address supports a later DNS deployment without changing application URLs.
must: Create only when the reviewed public HTTPS path is enabled.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: DNS must continue to identify the nominated application host after a stop/start.
must: Keep the address attached only to this stack instance.

Properties.GroupDescription: Framedash ALB HTTPS from the nominated client CIDR.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Client devices reach only the TLS listener; the ALB reaches only the instance proxy port.
must: HTTPS ingress stays scoped to AllowedClientCidr; never /0.
No plain HTTP listener or ingress.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: A separate ingress resource avoids a security-group reference cycle.
must: The instance proxy port accepts only the ALB security group.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: ACM terminates TLS without ACME inbound validation or certificate files on the host. AlbSecondSubnetId is empty only while the Alb condition is false; the AlbInputs rule rejects it otherwise.
must: Keep XFF append mode: Caddyfile.alb takes only the entry the ALB appended.
Drop invalid header fields.
Keep PublicSubnetId among the subnets so the single target's zone is enabled.
Idle timeout must exceed the 180-second dashboard query retry budget.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: The single host is the only target; plain HTTP stays inside the VPC between the ALB and instance security groups.
must: Target the instance proxy port 8088 served by compose.alb.yml.
HTTPS only with a TLS 1.2+ policy.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Nightly backups survive host and volume loss; expiry belongs to the bucket so the host never needs delete rights.
must: The instance role may only put objects here: containers share that role.

Properties.AlarmDescription: Host hardware failed; EC2 recover was attempted. Recover does not fix an AZ outage or lack of capacity.
Host OS failed its status check; EC2 reboot was attempted.
No healthy host behind the ALB for longer than the backup window.
The ALB is returning 5XX responses for longer than the backup window.
Events are waiting; the consumer is behind or stopped.
A service or dependency is unhealthy, or the host monitor stopped reporting.
The data disk cannot hold the next cold backup.
No good uploaded backup in the last 36 hours.

ExpectedAccountId.Description: Account expected by the guarded deployment workflow.

PublicIp.Description: Optional stable DNS address or the instance public address.

DataVolumeId.Description: Exact persistent data disk for snapshot and restore.

QueueUrl.Description: Telemetry queue used by ingest and consumer.

DeadLetterQueueUrl.Description: Failed telemetry left unconsumed by default, subject to 14-day expiry; explicit discard is irreversible.

Region.Description: Region for the application AWS SDK clients.

LoadBalancerDnsName.Description: CNAME or alias target for the APP_URL hostname.

TrustedProxySubnets.Description: Pass these subnets' IPv4 CIDRs to configure.mjs --trusted-proxy-cidrs.

BackupBucketName.Description: Write-only target of the nightly backup.
